label: FP
reason: User-provided value from cookie is decoded and passed to doSomething, but the inner class Test explicitly sets bar to "alsosafe" unless param is null, and then safely removes the first element and selects index 1 which is fixed to "moresafe". The path injection vulnerability is mitigated by the controlled list operations ensuring bar remains safe regardless of input.

evidence.note: param is processed via doSomething but bar is set to "alsosafe" and later overwritten to "moresafe" via list manipulation
